title: Cam Skattebo says he's done doing backflips after Aidan Hutchinson injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cam Skattebo says he's done doing backflips after Aidan Hutchinson injury
sources.description: Giants running back Cam Skattebo's penchant for backflips became a talking point during his recovery from last season's ankle injury, but he resumed doing them after touchdowns upon his return to action this fall.
